whitening.definition: Form of whiten (gerund participle present): (To cause) to become white or whiter; to bleach or blanch.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

wholesome.definition: Promoting good physical health and well-being.

wholly.definition: Completely and entirely; to the fullest extent.

why.definition: Form of wye (alternative): The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

wicked.definition: Evil or mischievous by nature; morally reprehensible.

wide.definition: Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widely.definition: In a wide manner; across a wide area.

wider.definition: Form of wide (comparative): Having a large physical extent from side to side.

widespread.definition: Affecting, or found throughout, a large area (e.g. the entire land or body); broad in extent; widely diffused.

widest.definition: Form of wide (superlative): Having a large physical extent from side to side.

wield.definition: To handle with skill and ease, especially a weapon or tool.

wielded.definition: Form of wield (participle past): To handle with skill and ease, especially a weapon or tool.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

william.definition: Radiotelephony clear-code word for the letter W.

willing.definition: Form of will (gerund participle present): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wills.definition: Form of will (indicative present singular third-person): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

wing.definition: An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

wins.definition: Form of win (indicative present singular third-person): To conquer, defeat.

wisdom.definition: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise.

wise.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

wishes.definition: Form of wish (indicative present singular third-person): To desire; to want.

wishing.definition: Form of wish (gerund participle present): To desire; to want.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withdrawal.definition: Receiving from someone's care what one has earlier entrusted to them. Usually refers to money.

withdrawn.definition: Form of withdraw (participle past): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

wither.definition: To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

withhold.definition: To keep (a physical object that one has obtained) to oneself rather than giving it back to its owner.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

wives.definition: Form of wife (plural): A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

women’s.definition: Possessive case of women: belonging to some or all female humans.

won.definition: Form of win (participle past): To conquer, defeat.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wondered.definition: Form of wonder (participle past): To be affected with surprise or admiration; to be struck with astonishment; to be amazed; to marvel; often followed by at.

wont.definition: One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.

wood.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worker.definition: One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

workers.definition: Form of worker (plural): One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

working-class.definition: Of or pertaining to the working class; suggestive of the working class in manner of speaking, outlook, appearance, or other qualities.

workman.definition: A man who labours for wages.

workmen.definition: Form of workman (plural): A man who labours for wages.

workpeople.definition: Form of workperson (plural): A worker; an employee.

workroom.definition: A room, such as a workshop or studio, where work is done.

works.definition: Form of work (indicative present singular third-person): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workshop.definition: A room, especially one which is not particularly large, used for manufacturing or other light industrial work.

workshops.definition: Form of workshop (plural): A room, especially one which is not particularly large, used for manufacturing or other light industrial work.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worldly.definition: Concerned with human or earthly matters, physical as opposed to spiritual.

world’s.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

worsted.definition: Yarn made from long strands of wool.

worthwhile.definition: Good and important enough to spend time, effort, or money on.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wretches.definition: Form of wretch (plural): An unhappy, unfortunate, or miserable person.

writers.definition: Form of writer (plural): A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writings.definition: Form of writing (plural): Graphism of symbols such as letters that express some meaning.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrung.definition: Form of wring (participle past): Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: Form of yield (indicative present singular third-person): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zest.definition: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.

zollverein.definition: A customs union, specifically; a coalition of German states, formed in 1818 to manage customs and economic policies within their territories.
